brand_identity.name: NexMart
brand_identity.core_identity: Bazaar meets Command Center. The chaotic, vibrant reality of Indian grocery stores, tamed by a crisp, high-contrast, technical OS layer.

color_system.usage_rules: Avoid large flat areas of color. Use Orange (Saffron) for CTAs. Use AI Indigo ONLY for Sentinel insights/chat. Rely on stark contrast for data grids. No generic purple/white gradients.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. High-density for Dashboards (gap-4, strict col-span logic). Wide/Asymmetric for Landing (gap-8, md:grid-cols-12).
spacing_and_layout.paddings: Use generous paddings (p-6, p-8) inside dashboard cards. Containers must have internal padding if they have borders.
spacing_and_layout.radii: Subtle roundness. max 8px (rounded-md) to retain a sharp OS feel.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders for Dashboards (expose the skeleton). Crystal Glassmorphism for sticky navbars (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70). NEVER use 100% transparent backgrounds over content.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders to ground elements. Use soft drop-shadow for floating UI (Sentinel). NO neumorphism.
visual_enhancers.motion: Framer Motion staggered entrances for lists. Number counters flip/tick smoothly.

component_design_specs.nav: Sticky glassmorphism header. Left: NexMart logo. Center: Navigation links. Right: User profile / Role Switcher + Notification Bell.
component_design_specs.stat_cards: Flat background, 1px border. Top: Title (mono label). Middle: Large KPI (mono). Bottom: % change (green/red) + sparkline.
component_design_specs.product_card: Top: edge-to-edge image. Middle: Title + Price + Neighborhood. Bottom: Inline stock meter + Add to Cart button.
component_design_specs.order_timeline: Vertical stepped list. Active step pulsing green dot. Future steps grayed out.
component_design_specs.sentinel_ai_cards: Tracing beam border effect (linear gradient mask). Icon: sparkles. Font: slightly tinted Indigo. Differentiates it from standard OS panels.
component_design_specs.demand_map: Dark map background. Heatmap overlays using glowing polygons for zones (T. Nagar, Adyar).
component_design_specs.live_ticker: react-fast-marquee. Mono font. 'Order #4092 Placed in Velachery | Stock Alert: Atta Low in Mylapore'.
component_design_specs.forms_and_tables: Dense. Left-aligned text. Right-aligned numbers. Inline steppers for inventory table.

page_level_direction.landing_page: High visual impact. Massive Typography. Live platform stat counters in the hero. 3 Role Cards built with Bento grid. Screenshot showcase using 3D perspective tilts.
page_level_direction.customer_module: Neighborhood-first discovery. Lush imagery of fresh produce. Sticky cart. Search with prominent natural-language placeholder.
page_level_direction.vendor_dashboard: Command center. Tight grids. Hourly sales chart (Recharts) front and center. Alert bar for low stock. High-density layout.
page_level_direction.admin_dashboard: Macro-level OS. GMV trends KPI Band. Demand Map side-by-side with Live Order Stream. Simulator controls for testing load.
page_level_direction.architecture_page: Technical, structural. Monospace heavy. Explains the multi-module hybrid nature. Grid background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react, recharts, sonner, react-fast-marquee, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Implement Shadcn UI primitives for tables, forms, dropdowns, but heavily customize them to remove standard 'Vercel' look by applying sharp 1px borders and disabling standard soft shadows.
Ensure the application strictly follows the multi-module routing: / (landing), /customer, /vendor, /admin.
Simulate realtime updates with useEffect and setInterval (e.g. randomly updating live stock quantities and order tracking).
universal_guidelines: Never use generic AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠).
Never use Inter, Roboto, Lato, or Space Grotesk for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk.
Never center-align the main app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Always apply 'data-testid' to key UI elements.
Do not use complete transparent background in header; use glassmorphism.
